query: Drop a progress comment on MD-1234 about what we did.
expected_behavior: Resolves the ticket key (from the message or the current branch) before drafting
Drafts a short, plain-language comment in prose with no bullets, no em dashes, no conventional-commit prefixes, and no code-y identifiers leaking into the text
Ends with a clear status pointer (what's next / current state) in a human teammate voice
Posts via acli only after the draft is right, rather than padding it with technical detail
